nodes.label: Robustness to resolution and contrast
nodes.rationale: Half-resolution copies give the same um results within 2% (~5x faster); darker/low-contrast copies give identical results.

nodes.label: Cellphi organoid measurement pipeline
nodes.rationale: Size estimate -> Cellpose cpsam with size hint -> dark-blob fallback, fragment cleanup, edge flagging -> equal-area diameter in um -> annotated image + CSVs. End user is a biology researcher, so defaults must work without tuning.

nodes.label: Unsupervised coverage/spill check (Otsu dark pixels)
nodes.rationale: Coverage = share of dark pixels inside an outline (mean 0.99 over 84 images; Plate 4-3 A3 at 0.69 due to edge shadow). Spill = share of outline pixels that are light (~0.06; ~0.2 for semi-transparent Cortical Plate 4).

nodes.label: Goal: organoid-specific fine-tuned Cellpose model
nodes.rationale: Fine-tuning on a few hand-corrected images would likely beat the fallback rules.

nodes.label: input/ dataset (Cortical and Midbrain organoids, 2048x1536 JPEG)
nodes.norm_label: input/ dataset (cortical and midbrain organoids, 2048x1536 jpeg)
nodes.rationale: Mostly solid black organoids on light background, ~250 um to ~4 mm. Unusual: Midbrain Plate 4-3 single huge organoid, Plate 5 blue fibres, Plate 3-2 B3 blurry, Cortical Plate 4 semi-transparent.

nodes.label: Dark-blob fallback (add_missed_dark_blobs)
nodes.rationale: Cellpose finds nothing for single very large featureless dark organoids. Unlabelled dark regions (3 px gap) with solidity >= 0.9 and >= 0.5x typical diameter are added; on 84 images adds exactly 14, all checked by eye.

nodes.label: Edge organoids measured and flagged (BORDER_MARGIN_PX = 2)
nodes.rationale: User's choice to measure and flag rather than exclude; 2 px margin because Cellpose masks often stop 1 px short. summary.csv has complete_ stats without them.

nodes.label: Overlap fragment detection and merge-back
nodes.rationale: Cellpose cannot output overlapping masks, so overlaps of semi-transparent organoids become lens labels. Lens: Feret/eq-diam >= 1.5 and >= 50% outline touching others; or small piece >= 90% enclosed and < 0.5x typical size. Pixels given to organoids whose convex hull holds >= 20% of it. Rarely triggers on opaque data but kept.

nodes.label: Size hint from image (estimate_diameter_px, single Cellpose pass)
nodes.norm_label: size hint from image (estimate_diameter_px, single cellpose pass)
nodes.rationale: Without a diameter hint cpsam covered ~33% of dark pixels (69% of hand-measured organoids found). Old two-pass retry failed when first pass found junk. Distance transform of Otsu dark foreground, local maxima with NMS, area-weighted median; within 0.93-1.31x of Cellpose median, ~15 ms, 2x faster overall. No hole filling (8x overestimates on packed clusters); no polarity check (border/connectivity rules wrong on 51/38 of 84 images).

nodes.label: Target environments (WSL2 CUDA, macOS, Colab)
nodes.rationale: RTX 5070 needs CUDA >= 12.8 torch; GPU optional with CUDA -> MPS -> CPU fallback (segment.pick_device); headless OpenCV, no PyQt; pip --extra-index-url cu128 works everywhere, uv may fail on macOS.

nodes.label: Calibration procedure (--scale-bar, --reference-size, --units-per-px)
nodes.rationale: Same field of view at other resolutions is scaled automatically (1024x768 -> 4.40 um/px); warns on shape mismatch suggesting cropping.

nodes.label: Diameter definitions (equivalent, mean_feret, max_feret, min_feret)
nodes.rationale: vs manual: equivalent +0.4% (6.9% avg diff), mean_feret +2.8%, max_feret +9.8%, min_feret -5.5%.

nodes.label: Drawn line is the reported diameter (diameter_line)
nodes.norm_label: drawn line is the reported diameter (diameter_line)
nodes.rationale: User request. Exact longest line for max_feret; otherwise chord through centroid closest to the diameter, scaled to exactly that length. Earlier caliper-extent placement left the outline on irregular organoids.

nodes.label: Default diameter = equivalent (equal-area) diameter
nodes.rationale: Against 284 hand-measured organoids: median ratio 1.004, mean abs error 6.9%, 79% within 10%. Max Feret reads +10%, so the lab measures a typical diameter. Max/min Feret remain in the CSV; --diameter switches.

nodes.label: numpy<2 pin for Intel Macs
nodes.rationale: Intel Macs only get PyTorch up to 2.2, which needs numpy 1.x.
